name: Mighty Networks
description: Mighty Networks is a hosted community platform for memberships, spaces, posts, courses, events, livestreams, chat, plans, and creator-led programs.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Admin API token and its exact Network ID. Agents can inspect reduced Network, Space, member, and Post metadata and make exact existing-user Space membership changes. Content bodies, member lifecycle, plans and money, structural administration, bulk actions, broader member data, and arbitrary API access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: MIGHTY_NETWORKS_ADMIN_API_TOKEN
credentialRequirements.label: Mighty Networks Admin API token
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated least-privilege Admin API key in the Network's Admin → Settings → API Keys page. Relay encrypts it and never exposes it to agents or clients after saving.

credentialRequirements.name: MIGHTY_NETWORKS_NETWORK_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Mighty Network ID or subdomain
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter the numeric Network ID or lowercase Network subdomain owned by this token.

blocked.label: Read or write content bodies
blocked.description: Post, Comment, Course, Poll, Event, Page, chat, livestream, attachment, file, and rich-media content is outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage member lifecycle
blocked.description: Creating, inviting, updating, banning, deleting, removing from the Network, changing roles, resetting passwords, or editing profiles is outside V1.

blocked.label: Manage plans or money
blocked.description: Plans, purchases, subscriptions, billing, payment access, plan membership, refunds, and financial state are outside V1.

blocked.label: Administer network structure
blocked.description: Creating, updating, deleting, archiving, reordering, or configuring Networks, Spaces, Collections, events, fields, tags, badges, webhooks, and settings is outside V1.

blocked.label: Run bulk or notification actions
blocked.description: Bulk loops, automatic pagination, polling, broadcasts, invitations, notifications, and workflow-like automation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Read broader member data
blocked.description: Avatars, location, timezone, bio, permalink, custom fields, tags, badges, activity details, and raw member records are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary Mighty APIs
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, query parameters, headers, bodies, alternate origins, Headless API tokens, and raw responses are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Reduced Network and Space catalog reads run directly. Member identity, Post metadata, Space membership inspection, and all membership changes require matching approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All selected bounded Mighty Networks V1 tools run without Relay per-action approval; encrypted token storage, exact Network binding, fixed origin and User-Agent, provider authority, bounds, audits, privacy reduction, and system blocks still apply.

providerSetup.blocker: No eligible representative Mighty Network, dedicated Admin API token, or staging member and Space fixtures were available for live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Mighty Networks administrator on an eligible plan creates a dedicated least-privilege Admin API key, enters it with the exact Network ID in Relay, and verifies Network binding, required User-Agent, reduced Space/member/Post projections, Safe approval binding, Dangerous execution, representative existing-user Space add/remove cycles, quotas, token rotation and revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in staging.

evidence.supports: The official Admin API uses the fixed api.mn.co origin, Network-scoped routes and Bearer tokens; it also requires a non-empty User-Agent, documents bounded pagination, quotas, and standard authorization and rate errors.
Network administrators create permission-scoped API keys in Admin settings, copy each token once, and authenticate with Bearer headers.
A Network is the top-level Admin API resource and each Admin API key is scoped to one Network.
The Admin API documents listing Spaces and Space members plus exact add and remove operations for an existing user in one Space.
The Admin API exposes member identity and profile records; Relay deliberately projects only bounded operational identity and role fields.
The Admin API documents bounded Network Post listing with optional Space filtering; Relay excludes bodies, URLs, media, and author email.
The official changelog documents current Business-and-above availability, API usage quotas, and token revocation.
Mighty Networks terms govern customer use of the service and automated access.
Mighty Networks' privacy policy explains the sensitivity and handling of member and Network data.
